description: Frozen confirmation set from two previously unused, openly downloadable 2025 papers. Questions and gold evidence were frozen before isolated retrieval and generation.
reclassification_reason: H3 generation trace was consumed and manually audited; the set is retained for regression only after a table-extraction failure.
freeze_policy: The original questions, gold answers, required facts, and aliases remain frozen. After reclassification, this set may guide development regression only; any confirmation after a fix requires a new unseen set.
